title: Hour of Devastation Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: A former initiate of the Tah-crop on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Tah-crop
entities.description: A crop of initiates on Amonkhet to which Djeru once belonged.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The God-Pharaoh of Amonkhet, whose arrival betrayed gods and mortals and who threatens the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who, to the end, did all for others.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who in his final moments sought logic in the chaos.

entities.name: The Locust God
entities.description: A god whose numberless children ate away the city's protection.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who wanted to be first among the God-Pharaoh's subjects.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who fought until his last breath; his monument held a collection of beasts.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker bound to demons, who came to Amonkhet to confront one of the two remaining.

entities.name: Razaketh, the Foulblooded
entities.description: One of the two remaining demons to whom Liliana is bound.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane ruled by the God-Pharaoh, with desiccated, blood-thirsty land.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A group of planeswalkers threatened by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city on Amonkhet whose confines once bounded the world.

entities.name: Hekma
entities.description: The protective barrier of the city, breached so the deserts swept in.

entities.name: Curse of Wandering
entities.description: A curse on Amonkhet's dead that ends when the last flesh is scoured away.

entities.name: Neheb, the Eternal
entities.description: An eternal whom Nicol Bolas presents as glory.

events.summary: The gate to the afterlife opened and the people prostrated themselves in the light of the God-Pharaoh.
events.quote: In the first moments, the gate to the afterlife opened, and the people were prostrate in the light of the God-Pharaoh.

events.summary: The arrival of the God-Pharaoh betrays gods and mortals.
events.quote: The arrival of the God-Pharaoh marked a betrayal of both gods and mortals.

events.summary: Oketra meets her end acting for others.
events.quote: To the end, all Oketra did was for others.

events.summary: Kefnet, dying, reaches into the minds around him.
events.quote: In his final moments, Kefnet reached into the minds of those around him, desperate for logic within the consuming chaos.

events.summary: The Locust God's children eat away the city's protection.
events.quote: The Locust God's children were numberless, relentlessly eating away every trace of the city's protection.

events.summary: Bontu meets her end still seeking to be first among the God-Pharaoh's subjects.
events.quote: To the last, Bontu wanted only to be first among the God-Pharaoh's subjects.

events.summary: Liliana comes to Amonkhet to confront the demon Razaketh.
events.quote: Liliana insisted on coming to Amonkhet to confront one of the two remaining demons to whom she is bound.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas declares his power over the Gatewatch.
events.quote: "Everything here exists or perishes at my whim. Including you, Gatewatch."

events.summary: The Hekma is breached and the deserts sweep into the city.
events.quote: With the Hekma breached and its protection removed, the deserts swept in.

events.summary: Rhonas fights until his last breath.
events.quote: Rhonas continued to fight until his last breath and even beyond.

events.summary: Rhonas's monument is destroyed, releasing his collection on the city.
events.quote: The destruction of Rhonas's monument released his collection upon the city.
